bibliographic-data.invention-title: SUBSTITUT DE CRÈME COMPRENANT DES PROTÉINES DE LÉGUMINEUSES

abstract.p: The present invention is situated in the field of food technology. The invention more specifically relates to a cream substitute wherein the milk or dairy-derived components, e.g. the milk protein component has been replaced by intact pulse protein. The invention further provides cream substitute products such as whipped cream, culinary cream, ice cream and milk dessert substitute as well as methods for producing these.
